title: The arrow keys steer the snake, all four directions
description: The snake already moves on its own; each arrow key in turn turns the snake in that direction, with the arrow keys alone enough to play.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. First watch without touching anything: the snake should already be moving. Then press the Up arrow key once and watch where the snake goes; then press the Left arrow key once and watch; then press the Down arrow key once and watch; then press the Right arrow key once and watch.
success: The snake was already moving on its own before any key was pressed
After pressing Up the snake turned and moved upward
After pressing Left the snake turned and moved leftward
After pressing Down the snake turned and moved downward
After pressing Right the snake turned and moved rightward
The game kept running smoothly with no error and no stuck board
